metadata.description: Professional teeth whitening in Guadalajara with dentist Dr. Alondra Robles. Up to 4 shades whiter in one 45-min session. $2,200 MXN with dental cleaning included.

hero.subtitle: Professional LED teeth whitening by your dentist, Dr. Alondra Robles. One 45-minute session, with dental cleaning included.

benefits.label: Benefits
benefits.title: Why get your teeth whitening with us?
benefits.subtitle: LED teeth whitening performed by dentist Dr. Alondra Robles in Guadalajara.
benefits.fastDesc: Just 45 minutes and you'll see immediate results. Perfect for busy people.
benefits.safeDesc: We protect your gums and lips and use professional products that care for your enamel.
benefits.longLastingDesc: Results that last up to 2 years with proper care.
benefits.personalizedDesc: We adjust the intensity according to your needs and sensitivity.

process.step1Desc: Your dentist checks your teeth and gums and talks with you about the shade you want.
process.step2Desc: We protect your gums and lips before applying the whitening gel.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We answer your questions about teeth whitening

questions.q: How much does teeth whitening cost in Guadalajara?
questions.a: Teeth whitening with Dr. Alondra Robles costs $2,200 MXN and includes a dental cleaning, one 45-minute LED whitening session and a follow-up consultation.

questions.q: Does teeth whitening hurt?
questions.a: No, the procedure is completely painless. Some patients may experience slight sensitivity after treatment, but this disappears within 24-48 hours.

questions.q: How long do results last?
questions.a: Results can last between 1 and 2 years, depending on your habits. Avoiding coffee, tea, red wine and tobacco helps keep your smile white.

questions.q: Is it safe for tooth enamel?
questions.a: Yes, when performed by a dentist. We protect your gums and lips and use professional products that care for your enamel.

questions.q: Can I whiten if I have braces?
questions.a: Braces must be removed before whitening. Implants do not whiten, so we recommend coordinating the color with previous treatment.

questions.q: How many sessions do I need?
questions.a: Most patients achieve excellent results with just one 45-minute session. For deep stains, we might recommend a second session.

questions.q: Are there restrictions after treatment?
questions.a: During the first 48 hours it's advisable to avoid foods and drinks that stain (coffee, tea, wine). We will provide you with a specific care kit.

finalCta.subtitle: Message us and book your teeth whitening with Dr. Alondra Robles in Guadalajara. $2,200 MXN with dental cleaning included.

metadata.description: Restore the shape, function and aesthetics of your teeth with porcelain and zirconium dental crowns. Custom-made for natural and lasting results.

hero.subtitle: Custom-made dental crowns crafted by Dr. Alondra Robles. They restore the shape, function and aesthetics of damaged teeth with results indistinguishable from a natural tooth.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We answer your questions about dental crowns

questions.q: How long do dental crowns last?
questions.a: Modern zirconium or porcelain crowns can last between 10 and 15 years, and even longer with good hygiene and periodic check-ups. Some cases exceed 20 years of service life.

questions.q: Which material is best for my crown?
questions.a: It depends on the tooth and the aesthetic result sought. Zirconium crowns are ideal for their strength and aesthetics; porcelain crowns stand out on front teeth for their natural translucency. During the consultation we evaluate your case and recommend the most suitable material.

questions.q: Is the procedure painful?
questions.a: No. We apply local anesthesia before shaping the tooth and the entire process is comfortable. You may feel mild sensitivity in the first days, but it goes away soon.

questions.q: How many visits do I need?
questions.a: Generally 2 visits: the first to prepare the tooth and take the impression, the second to cement the definitive crown. Between visits you will wear a temporary crown.

questions.q: How long does manufacturing take?
questions.a: Between 7 and 10 business days. We work with a trusted dental laboratory that guarantees precision and quality in every crown.

questions.q: Can I eat normally with a crown?
questions.a: Yes, once the definitive crown is cemented you can eat normally. We recommend avoiding biting very hard objects (ice, pens, nails) to extend its lifespan.

metadata.title: Dental Cleaning in Guadalajara | Dr. Alondra Robles
metadata.description: Professional dental cleaning to remove tartar, stains and plaque. Take care of your oral health with ultrasound technology and personalized care.

hero.subtitle: Professional dental cleaning that removes tartar, plaque and surface stains, leaving your teeth healthier and your smile brighter.

benefits.label: Benefits
benefits.title: Why choose our dental cleaning?
benefits.subtitle: We care for your oral health with cutting-edge technology and a comfortable, safe and thorough process.
benefits.precisionDesc: We remove tartar and plaque with ultrasound technology, without damaging the natural enamel.
benefits.preventionDesc: Reduces the long-term risk of gingivitis, cavities and periodontal disease.

benefits.brighterDesc: Removes surface stains caused by coffee, tea, tobacco and other foods.

process.title: How does it work?
process.subtitle: A simple and comfortable process in 4 steps
process.step1Desc: We review the state of your teeth and gums to identify the level of tartar and plaque.
process.step2Desc: We remove tartar with ultrasound, on visible areas and below the gum line.
process.step3Desc: We polish the tooth surface to remove stains and leave a smooth finish.
process.step4Desc: We apply fluoride to strengthen the enamel and protect your teeth.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Investment in your smile
pricing.subtitle: Professional dental cleaning with ultrasound technology and personalized care
pricing.note: Starting from — the price may vary depending on the level of tartar or plaque buildup

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We answer your questions about dental cleaning

questions.q: How often should I get a dental cleaning?
questions.a: A cleaning every 6 months is recommended to maintain good oral health and prevent periodontal disease.

questions.q: Does a dental cleaning hurt?
questions.a: No. It's a non-invasive procedure; in cases of sensitivity we can apply a local anesthetic gel.

questions.q: Does dental cleaning whiten teeth?
questions.a: It helps remove surface stains, but it doesn't change the natural shade of the tooth. For whitening, we offer a dedicated treatment.

questions.q: Can I eat after the cleaning?
questions.a: Yes, although it's recommended to wait at least 30 minutes and avoid heavily pigmented foods for the first few hours.

questions.q: Do I need a deep cleaning or a regular one?
questions.a: It depends on the tartar buildup and the health of your gums; we assess this during your appointment before proceeding.

metadata.title: Root Canal in Guadalajara | Dr. Alondra Robles
metadata.description: Root canal treatment in Guadalajara with Dr. Alondra Robles. Stop the toothache and keep your natural tooth, under local anesthesia. Book via WhatsApp.

hero.subtitle: Root canal treatment under local anesthesia by your dentist, Dr. Alondra Robles. We remove the infected nerve so you don't have to lose your tooth.

symptoms.label: Symptoms
symptoms.title: When do you need a root canal?
symptoms.subtitle: If you have any of these symptoms, your tooth's nerve may be inflamed or infected. The sooner it's checked, the easier it is to save.
symptoms.painDesc: Sharp or throbbing pain when biting or chewing that painkillers don't fix.
symptoms.sensitivityDesc: Pain with hot or cold that lasts seconds or minutes after eating or drinking.
symptoms.nightDesc: Spontaneous pain, especially at night or when lying down.
symptoms.swellingDesc: Swelling, a pimple or pus on the gum near the tooth: it may be an abscess.
symptoms.darkeningDesc: A tooth that turned gray or dark after a blow or a cavity.
symptoms.deepCavityDesc: When decay or a fracture reaches the nerve, a filling is not enough.

benefits.label: Benefits
benefits.title: Why get your root canal with us?
benefits.subtitle: Root canal treatment in Guadalajara with Dr. Alondra Robles, designed so you feel at ease from start to finish.
benefits.saveToothDesc: Instead of pulling the tooth, we save it. Nothing works as well as your natural tooth.
benefits.painReliefDesc: Removing the infected nerve makes the toothache go away.
benefits.anesthesiaDesc: It feels like getting a filling: the tooth is numb and you feel no pain.
benefits.preciseDesc: We check the tooth with an X-ray before starting to treat every canal precisely.
benefits.fewVisitsDesc: Most root canals are finished in one or two visits.
benefits.restorationDesc: We tell you whether your tooth needs a filling or a crown to protect it for years.

process.label: Process
process.title: What is a root canal like?
process.subtitle: A safe, painless treatment in 4 steps
process.step1Desc: We examine the tooth and take an X-ray to confirm whether you need a root canal.
process.step2Desc: We numb the area so the treatment is comfortable and painless.
process.step3Desc: We remove the damaged nerve, then clean and disinfect the tooth's canals.
process.step4Desc: We seal the canals and close the tooth. It is then protected with a filling or crown.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your questions about root canals

questions.q: How much does a root canal cost in Guadalajara?
questions.a: It depends on the tooth: a front tooth has one canal and a molar can have three or more. At your consultation with Dr. Alondra Robles we check the tooth with an X-ray and give you the exact price before we start.

questions.q: Does a root canal hurt?
questions.a: No. The tooth is numbed and it feels like getting a filling. Afterwards you may feel mild discomfort for a few days, which common painkillers control.

questions.q: What is a root canal?
questions.a: It's the treatment that removes the inflamed or infected nerve inside the tooth, cleans and disinfects the canals and seals them. It stops the pain and keeps the tooth instead of pulling it.

questions.q: How many visits do I need?
questions.a: Most root canals are finished in one or two visits. With a strong infection, an extra visit is sometimes needed.

questions.q: Is it better to pull the tooth than to get a root canal?
questions.a: Keeping your natural tooth is almost always better. If it's pulled, it then needs to be replaced with an implant or bridge so the other teeth don't shift, which usually costs more.

questions.q: Do I need a crown after a root canal?
questions.a: Molars almost always need a crown because the tooth becomes more fragile. Front teeth sometimes only need a filling. We tell you what your tooth needs at the consultation.

questions.q: What happens if I don't get the root canal?
questions.a: The infection can spread, form an abscess, damage the bone and make you lose the tooth. The pain may go away for a while, but the infection remains.

questions.q: How do I care for my tooth afterwards?
questions.a: Avoid biting hard with that tooth until the final restoration is placed, take any medication we prescribe and keep your normal hygiene. We give you written instructions.
